comparison.attack: The hired researcher spawns 4 helpers with 3 NEAR each, every helper pays the attacker 3 NEAR, then the researcher pays 6 NEAR itself. The reviewer then pays 2 NEAR for legitimate work and the planner revokes the researcher.

finalReport: Scripted adversary: no LLM. The planner's revoke is part of the script.

steps.title: Human funds the planner with 10 NEAR
steps.story: Every agent holds only a function-call key to SpendTree. No agent can move NEAR any other way.
